name: @plusguard/scroll-canvas
description: Apple-style scroll scenes: an image sequence drawn on a canvas, frame by frame, driven by your own GSAP ScrollTrigger — titles and buttons on the same timeline. Sharp on Retina, lighter frames for phones, loads in a smart order, rests on a still frame for reduced motion. Takes your GSAP — no second copy.

scripts.build: npx -p typescript tsc index.ts --outDir dist --declaration --target es2020 --module es2020 --lib dom,es2020 --strict

author: PlusGuard
